name: OMEN executes vulnerable candidate and blocks merge
description: Verifies OMEN computes the observations itself for the default visible-test-only patch and blocks it on the revoked-session counterfactual.
steps: Leave Deny expired sessions enabled and Deny revoked sessions disabled
Inspect the observations and policy decision
expected: The visible expired-session test passes with candidate 401, the revoked-session counterfactual fails with candidate 200, the audit trace is populated, and the decision is DO_NOT_MERGE.

name: OMEN executes remediated candidate and allows merge
description: Verifies enabling revoked-session denial changes executed candidate behavior and the policy result.
steps: Inspect both observations and the final decision
expected: Both candidate observations are 401 and PASS, and the decision is SAFE_TO_MERGE.

name: OMEN blocks a candidate that fails the visible requirement
description: Verifies disabling the expired-session guard causes OMEN to execute a failing visible test and block the candidate.
steps: Inspect the visible test and final decision
expected: The visible expired-session candidate status is 200, the visible test shows FAIL, and the decision is DO_NOT_MERGE.

name: Evaluation API failure is visible
description: Verifies a backend run failure is shown instead of leaving a stale result on screen.
expected: The page shows The evaluation did not complete. Run it again.
